title: Zesty Sichuan Lentils Stew
description: A floral, bouncy-qq one-pot stewed lentils dish that feels bright and spicy, served straight from a mason jar.

ingredients.name: French lentils (dried)
ingredients.notes: dry brine with 1 tbsp salt in 1 cup water for 30 min, then drain and pat dry

instructions: Soak the lentils in 1 cup water with 1 tbsp salt for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Heat the mason jar over medium heat and add sesame oil, then olive oil, garlic, ginger, Sichuan peppercorns, and chili flakes, sautéing for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the dry lentils and mixed vegetables to the jar, stirring to coat them with the oils and spices.
Pour in the vegetable broth, stir, and add coconut aminos; loosely place the jar lid on.
Transfer the jar to a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) and bake for 45 minutes, stirring gently if needed at 30 minutes.
After baking, let the jar sit for 5 minutes before removing the lid; the stew should be tender and aromatic.
Serve directly from the mason jar, garnishing with fresh cilantro if desired.
When cool enough to handle, clean the mason jar for future use.
